schoolName: Francisco Marroquín University Faculty of Medicine
reviewNotes: HOLD — UFM officially offers the Licenciatura en Médico Cirujano through its Faculty of Medicine. Its admissions page states a six-year duration and displays a first-semester price of Q58,197.00, comprising a Q11,639.40 first-payment registration charge and Q9,311.52 monthly payment, subject to change and course allocation. UFM also describes simulation-based learning and elective opportunities. However, the reviewed official material does not establish an international-applicant route, the programme language of instruction, a complete current multi-year fee schedule, student accommodation terms, or recognition/licensing evidence relevant to the intended study-abroad audience. The candidate remains held rather than being represented as publish-ready.
